subject: Launchpad kickoff — HealthSync workspace setup & API warmup
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@healthsync.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Launchpad kickoff — HealthSync workspace setup & API warmup

Alex —

Thanks again for the signature — excited to get HealthSync onto Redwood. To make the first week frictionless, the Implementation team and I want to confirm the initial org/tenant setup and the steps we need from your side for API access and admin seeding. Proposed plan (short):

1) Wed May 29: pre-kick checklist completed by your admin (names + emails, primary admin)
2) Thu May 30: 30-min kickoff (we can use the slot I proposed in the calendar link below)
3) Fri May 31: API key seed and initial test requests (dev sandbox)

To make progress now, please share: the primary admin you want seeded (name + email), any IP allowlists we should know about, and whether you want SSO enabled on day 1 or later. We will: create the workspace, seed one org-admin, create two service API keys (dev + staging), and share instructions for key rotation and role mapping.

I've copied Monica (CS lead) and Jonas (Implementation lead) — Jonas will own the seed steps and attachments. Ben will support the billing/procurement checklist if anything needs to be expedited.

Next steps: if you confirm the primary admin and the kickoff time (Thu May 30, 10:00 AM PDT), we will schedule the kickoff and run the seed Friday.

Thanks —
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: seed_key_instructions.pdf (guide), workspace-role-matrix.xlsx (template)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@healthsync.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@healthsync.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad kickoff — HealthSync workspace setup & API warmup

Thanks Rishi — this looks good. Confirming a kickoff on Thu May 30 at 10:00 AM PDT works for us.

Primary admin: Priya Rao (priya.rao@healthsync.com) — she will be our technical lead for the integration. We do not have a strict IP allowlist, but our security team will want the API keys stored in our vault (HashiCorp) and will request the key rotation guidance. We currently do not plan to enable SSO on day 1 — want to get the API flow stable first.

Two quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you confirm the minimum permissions needed for the seeded org-admin?
- Will the dev/staging keys be rate-limited by default, or can we keep a higher burst for initial testing?

Looking forward to the kickoff. Priya is on cc and will join the meeting.

Cheers,
Alex

To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@healthsync.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@healthsync.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad kickoff — HealthSync workspace setup & API warmup

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great — thanks for the quick confirmation. Short answers to your two asks plus seed plan: 

Minimum permissions for seeded org-admin:
- Full workspace admin: create projects, invite users, manage keys, configure roles. We recommend this role for the seeded primary admin for the first week so they can validate keys and invite early team members.

Rate limits for dev/staging keys:
- Dev keys: default low throughput, but we can open a temporary burst (we'll inject a policy for 48 hours) for your initial load testing.
- Staging keys: standard staging profile (higher throughput than dev). Production keys will be set to your committed quotas when you move to Dedicated.

What I'll deliver on Friday after the kickoff:
- Create HealthSync workspace and a project named "healthsync-integration"
- Seed Priya Rao as org-admin and share the admin invite flow
- Generate two service keys (dev + staging) and create them as secrets entries with a short-lived preview (we do not send raw keys over email — we'll provide a one-time secure retrieval link)
- Upload two artifacts to the shared folder: seed_key_instructions.pdf and workspace-role-matrix.xlsx

Pre-kick checklist (for Priya):
- Confirm primary admin email (done)
- Identify one test endpoint and sample payload for Friday test requests
- Confirm vault integration (HashiCorp) point-of-contact and whether HealthSync will pull the keys or want a push integration

Forwarding the two attachments here for reference (stubs attached): seed_key_instructions.pdf, workspace-role-matrix.xlsx

If Priya can paste the test endpoint and a sample JSON payload in the kickoff, we'll run a request live and validate headers/kv caching behavior.

Thanks —
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Priya (HealthSync): provide a single test endpoint + sample payload during kickoff (owner: Priya)
- Jonas (Redwood): create workspace, seed Priya as org-admin, generate dev/staging keys, and upload the two documents (owner: Jonas)
- Monica (Redwood CS): run the kickoff and collect success criteria for day 1 validation (owner: Monica)
- Ben (Redwood): monitor procurement checklist in case any billing post-signature items block seeding (owner: Ben)

I've scheduled the kickoff for Thu May 30, 10:00 AM PDT: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=healthsync-kickoff-20290530

If there are no objections, Jonas will run the Friday seed after the meeting and publish the secure retrieval links for the keys. I'll follow up with a short post-kick checklist and an internal access ticket for audit logs.

Thanks — excited to get you live.

Rishi
